Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 0  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner initially instructed the WebSurfer to focus on the signing date of the Lateran Treaty (11 February 1929) without fully considering that the treaty's ratification and entry into force on 7 June 1929 is the operative independence date. This oversight led to the incorrect conclusion that Vatican City became its own country on 11 February 1929 instead of the correct date of 7 June 1929.
